prompt: Write a detailed description of Tony from Alpha and Omega (2010).
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 provides the most coherent, film-aligned characterization of Tony as the Eastern Pack leader involved in the hierarchy-driven conflict and the planned match involving Kate (with relatively few highly dubious specifics). Candidate 3 is also on-theme but introduces several questionable or unsupported embellishments (e.g., distinctive headdress and “Great Games”) that reduce confidence. Candidate 2 contains multiple highly specific claims that are very likely hallucinated (including the voice actor and several plot/location details) and also misstates Tony’s role as a Beta rather than fitting the more central alpha-leader framing. Candidate 4 veers into an implausible and canon-incompatible “mail carrier on a bird-pulled sled” premise, making it the weakest overall.
